dialect.detail: IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS with CICS; uses PROCESS compiler directives (XOPTS, NOSEQ, LIB, OPTIMIZE), EXEC CICS, SYNCHRONIZED, COMP-2, COMP-5, POINTER, and dfheiblk linkage — all characteristic of IBM mainframe CICS COBOL

purpose.domain_detail: LegStar middleware integration — CICS COBOL program acting as a client to a SOAP web service (MSN Live Search) via the LegStar c2ws C API
purpose.summary: MSNSEARC is a CICS COBOL sample transaction that uses the LegStar c2ws (COBOL-to-Web-Service) C API to invoke the MSN Live Search SOAP web service. It constructs a search request for the query 'Mainframe', calls the remote service via an HTTP proxy, and processes the structured XML/SOAP reply mapped to COBOL data structures.

notable_features: LegStar c2ws C API integration (CALL 'init', CALL to invoke service)
POINTER and SET ADDRESS OF for dynamic data passing
SYNCHRONIZED clause for C-compatible struct alignment
Variable-length OCCURS DEPENDING ON arrays for SOAP response
dfheiblk passed to C API init call
No COPY statements — all structures inline
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars; the INVOKE-SERVICE and EPILOG paragraphs are not shown but their structure is implied. The program is a LegStar sample/demo but is written to production-quality standards with real MSN Live Search AppID and proper error handling patterns. Domain classified as 'other' because it is middleware/integration tooling rather than a specific business domain.
